title: A refused redirect hop leaves the redirect response open until garbage collection
goal: _Chain.redirect_request closes the redirect response (fp) before it raises _Refused, so a refused hop leaves no socket open. Found by the SP-ficl7pxl review (ST-mrrudfmj).
repro_reason: an unclosed socket shows only as a ResourceWarning at garbage collection, which depends on the interpreter's timing; the repro reads that redirect_request does not close fp before raising
